correctness.rationale: The 12 affine lines in F3² give exactly 12 complement facets, 339 nonempty faces and f-vector (9,36,84,126,72,12). The prescribed complete elementary face matching yields 163 pairs and critical cells one in dimension 0, eleven in dimension 3, one in dimension 4; the 1,260 face incidences orient acyclically. The explicit 36-support signed 4-cycle z has exact ∂z=0; cochain φ supported at 4-simplices indices 0 and 6 annihilates all boundaries of 12 five-simplices and has φ(z)=1, detecting primitive H4 and forcing the sole Morse 4-boundary to vanish. Since π3(∨11 S³)=Z^11, the 4-cell attachment is null, proving integral ∨11 S³∨S⁴ (not only Betti numbers). Four explicit generator differences g·z−z are boundaries of listed integral 5-chains; the generators yield all 432 AGL2(F3) elements, so H4 character is trivial. For every affine element independent signed-face Lefschetz summation gives χ3=det-sign×(fixed points+fixed directions−2), proving the rational module identity. Independent reconstruction found mod-two Betti 11 and 1, exact primitive cycle pairing and all 432 traces. Integral equivariant lattice of H3 is not claimed.
